profile.about: I'm a UI/UX designer with 3+ years of hands-on experience delivering intuitive, visually appealing digital products. I work in Figma with design systems and design tokens, and I lean on research, prototyping and iteration to solve complex design problems. I collaborate closely with developers, product managers and stakeholders to ship scalable, accessible, performance-minded interfaces, and I'm exploring how generative AI fits into design work.
profile.intro: I design intuitive, accessible interfaces for web and mobile, from research and wireframes to design systems and developer handoff.
